# Payslip Insights

> Payslip Insights helps employees in the United Kingdom and Ireland understand a payslip, review what changed, and make a simple plan to their next payday.

Payslip Insights is a personal payslip review, history, comparison, and payday-planning product. A person can upload a payslip they are entitled to use, review extracted figures before confirming them, see changes over time, and make a plan from confirmed net pay.

## Product scope

- Payslip review, explanation, comparison, and history
- Payday planning from confirmed payslip figures
- UK and Ireland employee-focused guidance
- A read-only product demo for visitors who want to explore the experience

## Important limitations

- Payslip Insights is not an employer, payroll provider, tax adviser, legal adviser, financial adviser, bank, or official payroll record.
- Automated extraction can be incomplete or incorrect. Customers should review their figures and contact payroll or a qualified professional when needed.
- The product does not link bank accounts, move money, manage investments, file taxes, or provide a verdict that a payslip is wrong.
